questions.instructions: Does the customer need a reply within the hour?
Which bucket does this ticket belong to?

options.name: outage
options.description: the service is unavailable, erroring, or badly degraded right now

options.name: feature_request
options.description: asks for something the product does not do

options.name: how_to
options.description: asks how to use an existing feature

notes: gt = primary label; alt = a second label a reasonable annotator could pick (borderline items only). A slot is counted correct against gt, and 'lenient' also accepts alt.

tickets.text: Subject: EVERYTHING IS DOWN. Our production dashboard has returned 502 for 40 minutes. Nobody can log in, customers are calling us, board demo at noon. Third outage this month. Fix this NOW or we cancel today.
Hi team, quick question when you have a moment: is there a way to export a report as CSV instead of PDF? I looked in Settings > Reports but only saw PDF. Thanks!
I was charged twice for the March invoice (INV-4471), $480 each. Please refund the duplicate. Card ending 2210. No rush, just want it sorted before the next cycle.
It would be great if the mobile app supported dark mode. Not a blocker, just a nice-to-have my whole team keeps asking about.
This is the fourth time I've written about the same wrong charge and every reply is a copy-paste apology. I want the $1,200 back this week and I want a human to actually read this.
API is returning 500 on every POST /v1/ingest since 09:10 UTC. Our pipeline is stalled and we're losing data. Status page says all green, which is not true. Need eyes on this immediately.
How do I add a second admin to our workspace? I found the Members page but the role dropdown is greyed out for me.
Honestly a bit disappointed. The webhook retries feature you announced in the newsletter isn't in our account and support chat said it's 'rolling out'. It's been three weeks. When?
Login page loads but the SSO button does nothing. Whole company locked out, 300 people, and payroll closes in two hours. Please treat as P1.
Can you explain the difference between the Team and Business plans? Specifically whether audit logs are included in Team. Deciding by end of month.
Your search is broken AGAIN. Half my results are missing, filters reset randomly, and this has been going on all morning. I have a client presentation in 30 minutes built on this. Unbelievable.
Feature idea: let us schedule reports to go out on the last business day of the month rather than a fixed date. Our finance team would love it.
Where do I find the API key for a service account? The docs mention a 'Credentials' tab but I don't see one under the account.
We were quoted $2,000/year and the invoice says $2,600. Someone added 'premium support' we never asked for. Remove it and reissue. This is sloppy.
Not urgent at all, whenever you get to it. Although our launch is Friday morning and the embed widget shows a blank frame on Safari, so ideally before then.
Our card expired, the renewal failed, and now the whole workspace is read-only. I've updated the card but nothing changed. We can't work.
Is there a way to bulk-archive projects older than a year? I couldn't find one, so maybe I'm missing it, or maybe it doesn't exist yet.
Well. That was fun. Spent my Saturday rebuilding a dashboard your migration 'preserved'. I'm sure it's fine. Please let me know if there's a backup, thanks so much.
The page is a little slow today, maybe 5-6 seconds to load a project. Not blocking, but it's noticeably worse than last week. Anything going on?
I need this fixed today: the invoice PDF shows our old company name. Our auditor won't accept it. It's a two-minute change on your side, I'd hope.
Following up on my request from last week, and the week before that, about the CSV import limit. I understand you're busy. I would appreciate any update at all.
Getting 'rate limit exceeded' on maybe one request in twenty since this morning. We retry so it's not breaking anything, but is this a change on your end or are we doing something wrong?
Hey, love the product. Just wondering if the Slack integration can post to a private channel? I tried and it only lists public ones. If not, consider this a vote for it :)
We have a customer-facing demo in 90 minutes and the export button intermittently does nothing. It works maybe two out of three clicks. I can live with it but would rather not.
Please cancel our subscription effective immediately and confirm no further charges. We've moved to a competitor. Nothing personal, the product just didn't fit.
The new editor is objectively worse. Keyboard shortcuts changed with no notice, and undo eats two characters at a time. Is there a way to switch back? If not, that's a problem.
Dashboard down for us since 3am. Only affects our EU workspace, US is fine. We've told our on-call to wait for you. No hurry on my side but the EU team starts in an hour.
Two questions: how do I download all invoices for 2025 in one go, and why does the January one show a $0 credit we never received? The second one matters more.
It's fine. I've given up on the sync working reliably and set up a cron to reupload every night. Would still be nice if it just worked. Closing this unless you have something.
URGENT URGENT URGENT: how do I change the color of the sidebar? My boss wants it to match our brand before a screenshot goes out tomorrow.
